description: Header file declaring functions and includes related to HTTP chunk processing in the project.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_mem
methods.description: Copies memory into an HTTP chunk for the given request.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_buffer
methods.description: Appends a buffer to the HTTP chunk, may reset the buffer.

methods.name: http_chunk_decode_append_mem
methods.description: Decodes and appends memory data to the HTTP chunk.

methods.name: http_chunk_decode_append_buffer
methods.description: Decodes and appends buffer data to the HTTP chunk.

methods.name: http_chunk_transfer_cqlen
methods.description: Transfers data from a source chunkqueue to the request, with specified length.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_file_fd
methods.description: Appends a file descriptor's content to the HTTP chunk.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_file_ref
methods.description: Appends a file reference to the HTTP chunk.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_file_fd_range
methods.description: Appends a range of a file descriptor to the HTTP chunk.

methods.name: http_chunk_append_file_ref_range
methods.description: Appends a range of a file reference to the HTTP chunk.

methods.name: http_chunk_close
methods.description: Closes or finalizes the HTTP chunk for the request.
